steps.name: Priya declines a suggestion privately — nothing is written, nobody else can see it, it is not offered again, and Undo restores it
steps.description: "Not me" transitions a suggestion to Declined with no write-port access; declined keys are suppressed from the queue; Undo returns it to Pending; declining twice is idempotent. Lifecycle state machine (Pending ⇄ Declined, Pending → Published → Retracted) as a pure ADT with legal transitions only.
criteria: DC-1: declining writes nothing to any PDS and the PDS universe is unchanged.
